test_title: PYST 07: SSC MTS 2024 - English Language and Comprehension (Held On: 08 Oct, 2024 - Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate verb / verb phrase to fill in the blank.

In 2030, advancements in technology ______________ the way we live, work and interact with each other.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The verb phrase "**will be reshaping**" is the most appropriate to fill in the blank as it indicates a future continuous action that will happen in 2030.
 
• The other options (could be reshaped, shall have been reshaped, have reshaped) do not accurately convey the intended future ongoing action in the sentence.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Could be reshaped:** This is incorrect as it implies a possibility rather than a definite future action.
 
• **Shall have been reshaped:** This is incorrect as it indicates a completed action by 2030, which does not fit the context of a continuous future action.
 
• **Have reshaped:** This is incorrect as it refers to a past action, while the sentence is about a future scenario.
